transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

Just... having some trouble at my apartment building. The people living there, they're... they're watching my comings and goings. They keep slipping notes about me down to the office. Everybody keeps telling me it's just... you know, regular notices they tape on the doors. But I know what they're doing. So... that's why I came in.
How long have you felt that the people in your apartment building have been watching you and leaving notes about you?
It's been... a while. I guess... maybe a year. A year and a month, about.
Have you experienced any other unusual thoughts or beliefs that others might find strange, outside of what you've described about your neighbors watching you?
No, not really. Just the stuff at the building. I don't... I don't know what else you mean. It's just the neighbors.
Have you ever believed something strongly that others around you didn’t believe, even when there was no clear evidence to support it, aside from the situation with your neighbors?
No. Like I said... it's just the building. I don't... I don't really know what else you're looking for.
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that felt very real to you, but others didn’t seem to understand or agree with — even when there wasn’t clear proof to back them up?
Look, I... I already told you. No. There isn't anything else. Just what I said about the building. I don't... I don't really get why we keep going in circles here.
Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs or ideas that you’re absolutely sure about, even if others didn’t share them or there wasn’t clear proof?
No. I... I don't know how many different ways I can say it. There's nothing else. Just... no.
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed something that others around you didn’t seem to notice, even when there was no clear explanation for it?
No. I haven't. I don't see things that aren't there.
